facts.text: Berklee College of Music requires applicants to complete a live audition assessing performance, improvisation, sight-reading, and ear training.

sources.title: Audition Guidelines | Berklee College of Music
sources.quote: The live audition is an opportunity for you to showcase your current level of musicianship, potential for growth, and readiness to succeed in our unique learning environment to Berklee College of Music faculty members.
